minimum_recipe_recommendation.default: Fail closed: no automatic ObservedFamily-wide allow. Extra IDs/normalized duplicates/JSON ambiguity refuse using existing owned validation.
minimum_recipe_recommendation.source_binding: The pinned profile/source/registry identities bind scope. Historical hold IDs are evidence leads, not permanent assertions about arbitrary future images; lifting holds requires explicit review for current pins. Do not parse notes by regex.
minimum_recipe_recommendation.human_machine: EN always unchanged. Suggest only owned machine fields; preserve progressed status. patch_ref needs explicit attribution data or remains unchanged/omitted; reason/Evidence is not migration origin.
minimum_recipe_recommendation.cost: No new function/mode-flag framework justified; existing audit row loop can attach review/hold/candidate reasons; authorRegistry stays separate publisher.
minimum_recipe_recommendation.qualification: Conceptual recipe semantics only, not a new production API. Prior17manual scenario booleans must never become accepted proof-input fields.
